summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The WisdomTree International Equity Fund (DWM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the WisdomTree International Equity index. The fund tracks a dividend-weighted index of dividend-paying companies in developed markets excluding Canada and the US. DWM was launched on Jun 16, 2006 and is issued by WisdomTree.

holdings.infoBox: DWM is an equity ETF with a total of 1411 individual holdings. The top holdings are HSBC Holdings stock at 1.77%, Intesa Sanpaolo at 1.27%, Shell at 1.17%, Novartis AG at 1.11%, and Toyota Motor at 1.10%.
